split_policy: Whole collection runs; train/validation/test have disjoint KLT area groups

training.checkpoint_policy: Lowest class-weighted validation BCE; patience 6; threshold chosen afterwards on validation F1
training.context_policy: Same trip/device/satellite; past/current only; reset on >5000ms gaps; left-pad first observation; unknown labels may supply observed history

selection_policy: Highest validation F1; threshold fixed on validation; no test tuning
comparison_policy: Complete classifiers, no component ablations. LR/RF/rule use current features; Transformer additionally uses past observations. This is not an isolated architecture comparison.
warning: Real KLT NLOS labels. Four short runs from one date and receiver; one held-out area is not city/device generalization.
evaluation_limitations: Satellite rows within an epoch and run are correlated, not independent trials.
Test covers 1 run(s) and 1 area group(s); no independent-drive confidence interval estimated.
LOS includes possible multipath. No obstruction object type or untracked-satellite label.
Reference label accuracy and upstream feature extraction are not independently verified by this classifier.
No positioning improvement established by this classification-only table.
Test area has been inspected during development; further tuning requires a new untouched final holdout.

source.features_origin: Published KLT radio/SPP features; C/N0 zero sentinels masked and trailing std recomputed locally; no raw RINEX re-extraction
